article_content: A clock in the background of a Marvel scene has sparked controversy over its potential AI origins. Initially, the image seemed normal, but upon closer inspection, it revealed disconnected lines, strange digital artifacts, and symbols that appeared to be formless. The Roman numeral 'IIII' was also incorrectly used. Twitter user and artist Katria first raised concerns about the image's possible AI origins, and even found the background image on Shutterstock to highlight the hallmarks of AI-generated art. Another user, Svarun, has a large collection of photos that also appear to be AI-generated, but failed to categorize them as such. Additional reporting revealed that Shutterstock requires users to tag AI-generated stock with special tags, which Svarun did not do. Furthermore, when the image was run through four apps that check for AI-generated work, three of the programs confirmed it was AI-generated. This comes after Marvel faced criticism for using AI-generated opening credits in their previous Disney+ series, Secret Invasion. In an interview, the director-showrunner of Secret Invasion, Ali Selim, admitted to not fully understanding how AI-generated images work.
